gap_details.2011-2012: SIGNIFICANT. The only capture in the AY (georgiahealth.edu residents/index.htm, 2011-09-16) is the stale 2010-11 page (revised 2010-08-06; Ahmed Shakir, grad 2011, still chief). No other capture Jan 2011-Dec 2012 on mcg.edu/georgiahealth.edu (prefix CDX, any status). Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2012: 2 records on the georgiahealth prefix, none roster. PubMed affiliation scan 2011-15 found no unknown resident. Reconstructed 7 bracketed/alumni-confirmed people (Youssef 6, Hughes PGY ambiguous 5/6, Wang 5, B. Shakir 4, N. Woodall 3, Viers 2, Yowtak 2). The PGY-1 (2011 entrant) is unknown: the 2012-13 roster lists no PGY-2, so a 2011 intern could have entered and left unseen (or the program took no 2011 resident). PHASE 2: gapaudit of mcg.edu/georgiahealth.edu neurosurgery, surgery, GME and news hosts (2011-05..2012-12) and the whole www.georgiahealth.edu host (2011-07..2012-12): no roster in the AY. The 2011 GME programs booklet says neurosurgery accepts 1/year (7 years), but the 2010 class had two (Viers, Yowtak), so a 2011 slot may have been skipped. GHSU IRIS match table: 2 MCG graduates matched neurosurgery in 2011 (destinations not given). PubMed 2011-14 MCG/GHSU/GRU neurosurgery affiliation scan: the unknown names are students (Hester, Smitherman = Oklahoma 2013 entrant, Whitaker-Lea = VCU), plus the Cormican lead (see year_status). Still significant.
